summary: Phase 6C.4 — Backend 23/23 pytest PASS for AI wallet, admin grant/report, research-collab (synthesize-literature live with Elena returned markdown sections + cost_usd), vendor-ai (write-description + suggest-price live debited demo's wallet), assistant metering, my-sessions/last endpoint. Frontend mostly PASS: /dashboard/ai-wallet renders balance + topup packs 10/25/50/100 + auto-recharge form + recent usage table; menu 'AI Wallet' link works for signed-in user; /admin/ai-usage page renders with days-7/30/90/365 chips + usage-table + wallets-table; AdminDashboard has 'AI usage' QuickActionCard linking to /admin/ai-usage; Research Collaborator drawer (data-testid=research-ai-panel) opens with subtitle 'AI Research Collaborator', Inquiry/Drafting groups, all 7 tabs (synthesize/landscape/questions/critique/summarize/tags/polish) present; anonymous concierge 'take me to the workshops page' still navigates correctly with no balance gate. CRITICAL BUGS FOUND: (1) AssistantWidget.jsx referenced <History> icon without importing it from lucide-react — caused 'Illegal constructor' uncaught runtime error on every page that mounts AssistantWidget for a signed-in user (the assistant FAB has a History replay button). This crashed the entire React tree and broke /dashboard/partner/products, /dashboard/partner/research while signed in, and the assistant panel itself. FIXED by adding `History` to the import. (2) VendorPDMPanel.jsx imported `ImageIcon` which is not exported by lucide-react v0.507 (only `Image` is, but that conflicts with window.Image and throws Illegal constructor when used as JSX). FIXED by aliasing `Image as ImageIcon`. After both fixes, assistant-replay-btn is now PRESENT and the home page no longer crashes. Synthesize-literature E2E from the React panel was triggered but the click on the 'Synthesize' action button did not surface a markdown-result within 45s in this run — backend pytest confirmed the endpoint itself works (~10–12s, 2.8KB markdown, $0.0116 debit) so this is likely either a longer LLM latency on standard depth or a frontend wiring issue; recommended for main-agent re-verification with depth=brief explicitly selected before clicking Synthesize.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `History` import from lucide-react caused 'Illegal constructor' TypeError when signed-in user mounted the widget — crashed every authenticated page that mounted it (every page).

`ImageIcon` is not exported by lucide-react v0.507; rendering <ImageIcon /> fell through to window.Image and threw 'Illegal constructor'. This crashed /dashboard/partner/products (because the panel is imported at the top of VendorProducts.jsx and React evaluated the JSX).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Synthesize literature' on the panel with topic='attachment repair in adoptive families' (depth left at Standard default) did not render [data-testid=markdown-result] within 45s during the E2E test. Backend pytest with depth=brief succeeded in ~10s and returned 2.8KB markdown with $0.0116 debit, so the endpoint works. Likely a UX gap: standard/deep depth has >45s LLM latency or the result rendering needs to be inspected.

The two remaining issues are: (1) /dashboard/partner/products may still hide vendor-pdm-open for demo (look at VendorProducts.jsx:155 condition vs /partner-profiles/me response) and (2) the synthesize button flow's markdown-result render timing — pick depth=brief explicitly in the panel before clicking Synthesize and wait up to 30s.
rca of the issue: Two undefined lucide-react named exports (`History` in AssistantWidget.jsx, `ImageIcon` in VendorPDMPanel.jsx — both were not importable in lucide-react@0.507) caused JSX elements to resolve to `undefined`, which React falls through to the global window constructor — `window.History()` and `window.Image()` respectively — and both throw 'Illegal constructor' because they aren't user-callable. Because AssistantWidget mounts on every page for signed-in users, every authenticated page crashed at render time, which is why /dashboard/partner/products and /dashboard/partner/research appeared broken even though their own code is fine. Fix applied: import History from lucide-react; alias the unaliased `Image` as `ImageIcon` so the JSX resolves to the lucide SVG component.
